concept: Qrack execution depends on PyQrack and host accelerator runtime availability
summary: OpenQEvo's Qrack adapter is executable through the registered qrack_trotter method, but accelerator behavior depends on PyQrack, Qrack, and the host OpenCL/GPU runtime; this is why the adapter remains experimental until GPU validation passes.
limitations: GPU execution requires a working host accelerator runtime, not only a GPU device.
OpenQEvo CPU-mode validation does not prove GPU/OpenCL validation.
The current adapter extracts a full unitary by evolving basis states, which can be expensive as system size grows.
implications: Keep qrack_trotter labeled experimental until host GPU/OpenCL validation succeeds.
Recommendations using qrack_trotter should include backend requirements and avoid implying GPU availability unless runtime checks pass.
Use is_gpu only when the caller has confirmed a compatible Qrack accelerator runtime.

evidence.note: Documents the Qrack simulator project and accelerator-oriented runtime context.
Documents the Python package path used by OpenQEvo's Qrack adapter.
